whatIs: quicktype generates typed code from data: you give it sample JSON, an API URL, a JSON Schema or a GraphQL query, and it produces models, serializers and validators in more than 25 languages, including TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Swift, Kotlin and Zod.

You can use it from the web app, from the command line with npm install -g quicktype, or from its MCP server for AI agents. It's a good fit when you consume an API and don't want to write the types for each response by hand.
uses: Pasting an API response and getting the TypeScript interfaces for your client.
Generating the same models in Swift and Kotlin so two mobile apps share a structure.
Creating Zod schemas from sample JSON to validate data at runtime.
caveats: Types are inferred from the samples you provide: if a sample doesn't include an optional field, the result won't reflect it. Use several samples or a JSON Schema.
Review the generated code before integrating it, especially class names and fields that mix several types.
The code is published on GitHub under the Apache-2.0 license; the most recent release is from July 2026.
pricingNote: Open source project under the Apache-2.0 license.
idealFor: Developers who consume JSON APIs and want types without writing them by hand.
